title: Constructor selected by name at runtime (java)
description: The code obtains a constructor through cls.getDeclaredConstructor. The class and constructor are chosen from strings at runtime, so a value that reaches them instantiates a type the application never intended to create.
remediation: Keep constructor lookup on constant types and an allowlist, for example a factory with an explicit class map.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the lookup without tracing the class name.
